counting_rules: Fact accuracy is counted per fact (transfer, route stop, exchange deposit, bridge exit, merge, limitation).
A scenario passes only if all expected routes are found and there is no false fact.

Source unavailability is excluded from the denominator but counted and reported separately: facts behind a designed outage or index gap leave the fact denominators; scenarios with a designed source failure leave the pass-rate denominator and are reported on their own line.
case-001 is a development reference and is never part of the held-out set.
notice: Held-out set: not for development or tuning. See README.md.
